description:
Handled Locator is store locator software for any website: a searchable, branded map of your shops, dealers, stockists or service areas that you embed with one script.

This connector puts it in ChatGPT. Add locations by name and address and they are geocoded for you. Update hours, phone numbers, websites, photos and custom fields by asking. Find which location is nearest a customer. Get the embed code for your site.

It also changes how the locator itself looks and behaves. Ask for your brand colours, a different result layout, a wider search radius or new wording, and it prepares the change and shows you exactly what would differ before anything goes live. You approve it, and it takes effect on your website. Every version is kept, so any change can be undone, and a deleted location stays recoverable.

Ask things like: "Add our new Chicago location with weekend hours." "Which shop is closest to downtown Austin?" "Make the locator match our brand colours and use bigger cards." "Give me the embed code for WordPress."

defaultPrompt: Add our new Chicago location with weekend hours
Which of our shops is closest to downtown Austin?
Make our locator match our brand colours
